en: Color postcard showing a panoramic view of a valley town surrounded by mountains, identified as Trento with the Valsugana railway. In the foreground a steam locomotive with passenger cars travels along a raised railway line; below it is a long arched viaduct. Tree branches frame the upper right. In the upper right corner there is a printed stamp-like vignette with an allegorical female figure and two children and the words "LEGA NAZIONALE".
